faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JNCASR ARF Instrument Scientist position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 31-08-2026. It is advisable to send your application well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Chemistry or Physics to be eligible for the ARF Instrument Scientist position at JNCASR.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the ARF Instrument Scientist post is 45 years.

faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 650000 Per Annum.

faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your bio-data, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official email address before the last date.

faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.
